scope: H67/Motion twelve-FFN no-running BN1 plus rank-3 ATLIF right-projection fusion

local_intermediate_bit_dse.qualification: Local intermediate-buffer bit counts under the stated candidate widths; not SRAM/DRAM transactions, cycles, energy, or system speedup.

rank3 PAFT accuracy and fixed-point order validation

algorithm_feedback.preferred: Fine-tune/calibrate a frozen-running-BN deployment checkpoint and validate against no-running baseline to remove both global BN barriers.
algorithm_feedback.fallback: Train rank-3 with dynamic BN correction after Q24 right projection; separately test Q8 early requantization.
algorithm_feedback.hardware_mask: fc1 rows + BN1 hidden moment state + sn2 hidden activation/lane state + fc2 columns; temporal factors remain shared.

paper_safe_statement: For the frozen no-running BN protocol, current-batch normalization can be applied after a rank-3 temporal right projection by correcting the rank state with per-channel moments. A 32-lane moment path matches the ideal input rate of the existing 96-slot rank-3 projection, and the explicit-width local intermediate bit-movement candidate is 4.20x lower at Q24. No accuracy, fixed-point, cycle, or system speedup is admitted.
